purpose: Teach: 旦那/友だち/僕たち/中華/居酒屋/あいさつ/さっそく/金曜日

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お祖母ちゃんの、絶対、旦那、絶対、さま、絶対、お会いしてきたわ
lines.en: Sho, I actually went and met Granny's husband the other day.
lines.style: Warm, natural opening—like sharing something she's been thinking about. Soft voice, genuine. A small smile in it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、友だち、絶対、ぴょんちゃん、絶対、紹介、絶対、したいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to introduce you to my friend Pyon-chan sometime.
lines.style: Bright, earnest rush of words. The kind of excitement that comes from wanting to connect people you care about. Leans forward slightly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんと、本気で、絶対、僕たち、絶対、家族、絶対、いつも、絶対、楽しいよね、翔くん
lines.en: You know, with you around, we always have so much fun, Sho. It's like we're really family.
lines.style: Tender, almost thoughtful. A beat of warmth before speaking. Slow, deliberate—like she's saying something she means deeply.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、中華、絶対、ラーメン、絶対、大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love ramen. Like, a lot.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact enthusiasm. Not performing—just simple, genuine certainty about what he likes. Small and clear.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お友達と、絶対、居酒屋、絶対、で、絶対、お祝い、絶対、してきたわ、翔くん
lines.en: We actually celebrated with friends at an izakaya the other night, Sho.
lines.style: Animated, brighter than before. There's lightness here—a good memory. Speaks with a little more energy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、毎朝、絶対、あいさつ、絶対、ちゃんと、絶対、するよ
lines.en: I make sure to say good morning every single day, you know.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Speaking carefully, like he's keeping a promise. Small smile—not boastful, just steady.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: さっそく、本気で、絶対、メイ姉さん、絶対、お返事、絶対、お送りするわね、翔くん
lines.en: I'll send you a reply right away, Sho.
lines.style: Tender, reassuring. The kind of care that's in the delivery. Warm and present—no rush, but attentive.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、金曜日、絶対、お祖父ちゃんち、絶対、行くんだ
lines.en: I'm going to Grandpa's house on Friday, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Bright statement of fact. A little anticipation underneath. The certainty of a child looking forward to something specific.
